items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Project timelines vary depending on scope. Most projects are delivered within 4–8 weeks.

items.question: What is your pricing model?
items.answer: We offer fixed-price packages for common projects and hourly rates for custom work.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
items.answer: Yes, we offer monthly maintenance and support packages for all completed projects.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Simply fill out our contact form or give us a call. We will respond within one business day.

cta.heading: Interested in working together?
cta.subtext: Get in touch and we will put together a proposal tailored to your needs.
